For thousands of families across India, raising an autistic child comes with a slew of challenges. Finding the right support. Delayed diagnoses. Very few trained professionals. Therapy that remains out of reach for many.
But every child deserves the opportunity to learn, grow and thrive.
This is a small step. Yet, it is a life-changing milestone for both the child, parents and therapists.
CognitiveBotics is bridging the gap by connecting therapy, school and home to help children build everyday skills, because .
